subject: The comparison should be repeated after excluding unreliable readings and varying uncertain handoff times and sensor-response assumptions.
rationale: The proposed repetition directly instantiates S002's sensitivity testing of uncertain evidence and assumptions. Reading reliability, handoff timing and sensor response bear on distinguishing warming stages from measurement differences in this target. Comparing results under these changes can reveal whether explanatory rankings depend on uncertain inputs. Exclusion criteria and variation ranges remain implementation details to specify; no completed assessment, stable ranking or causal finding is established.
